backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing fuel station management with user profiles, tanks, sales (with totalizer and saleDate fields), expenses, staff, shifts (with shiftDate), cash collections, price updates, Stripe integration, and access control using migration for upgrades.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts old actor state to new state by adding openTotalizer, endTotalizer, and saleDate fields to Sale records and shiftDate to Shift records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: date picker for backdated sales, totalizer input fields, automatic volume calculation, and shift date/time pickers in the frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including SalesForm with totalizer fields and date picker, ShiftManagement with date/time pickers, offline support hooks, staff management, analytics, and authentication components.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and OKLCH color system variables defining light and dark theme design tokens for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx for the Fuel Inventory Management application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router setup, authentication guard using Internet Identity, profile setup flow, auto-sync hook, and route definitions for all dashboard pages including tanks, sales, staff, shifts, expenses, and analytics.
frontend/src/components/AlertsPanel.tsx: Displays active and resolved tank alerts based on threshold levels, showing tanks requiring refills with detailed volume information and links to update tank levels.
Renders visual analytics using Recharts including sales trends over time, fuel type revenue/volume comparisons, and transaction counts with line and bar charts.
frontend/src/components/CashCollectionEn: Manages cash collection recording with form input, displays today's sales vs collected cash, calculates discrepancies, and shows collection history in a table.
frontend/src/components/CommissionCalcul: Calculates and displays staff commissions based on sales performance, showing breakdown by staff member with sales counts, totals, commission rates, and earned amounts.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard overview showing key metrics (active alerts, current shift, today's revenue, total tanks), includes APK generation information banner with links to Capacitor/Cordova.
Provides the main application layout with sidebar navigation for all routes, user profile display, admin-only sections, offline status indicator, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseLogger.ts: Component for logging and viewing station expenses with offline support, category-based tracking, and real-time sync status. Displays expense history in a table with category breakdowns and handles both online and offline expense recording.
frontend/src/components/FuelTypeAnalytic: Displays comparative analytics between petrol and diesel sales, showing volume sold, revenue, transaction counts, and percentage breakdowns for each fuel type.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/OfflineStatusInd: Status bar component showing connection state, pending sync items count, sync progress, and manual sync trigger button with toast notifications for sync events.
frontend/src/components/PaymentFailure.t: Simple error page component displaying payment failure message with a return-to-dashboard button.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSuccess.t: Simple success page component displaying payment confirmation message with a return-to-dashboard button.
frontend/src/components/PriceUpdateModul: Admin-only component for updating fuel prices and viewing price history, with current prices display and form for submitting new prices by fuel type.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form component for new users to create their profile with name, phone number, and staff role selection.
frontend/src/components/ProfitLossDashbo: Displays a financial dashboard with cards showing total revenue, expenses, net profit/loss, and profit margin calculated from sales and expenses data. Includes revenue and expense breakdowns with visual indicators for profit/loss status.
frontend/src/components/SalesForm.tsx: Form component for recording fuel sales with fields for fuel type, quantity, staff selection, date/time, and totalizer readings. Supports offline mode by storing sales locally when disconnected and syncing when online.
frontend/src/components/SalesReports.tsx: Sales reporting component with tabbed views for daily, weekly, and monthly periods, displaying revenue metrics, fuel type breakdowns, and transaction tables. Calculates totals and volumes for petrol and diesel sales.
Manages staff shifts with functionality to start and end shifts, displaying active shift information and allowing custom date/time selection. Shows shift details including staff member, timestamps, and status badges.
frontend/src/components/ShiftReport.tsx: Displays comprehensive shift reports in a table format showing shift details, staff assignments, timestamps, sales counts, and revenue. Includes fuel breakdown calculations for petrol and diesel sales per shift.
React component for managing staff members with CRUD operations, including adding, editing, and removing staff with roles and commission rates. Validates Principal IDs and enforces permission checks for staff management operations.
frontend/src/components/StockReconciliat: Displays daily stock reconciliation by comparing calculated closing stock (opening + purchases - sales) against actual closing stock for each tank, highlighting variances. Shows reconciliation table and variance analysis for fuel inventory management.
frontend/src/components/TankMonitor.tsx: React component for monitoring fuel tank levels with visual progress indicators, allowing users to add new tanks and update existing tank volumes. Displays tank capacity, current volume, and threshold information for each fuel storage tank.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, using Internet Identity for authenticated users or anonymous actor otherwise. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes due to identity updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutoSync.ts: Automatically syncs offline data when connection is restored, monitoring connection state changes and triggering synchronization of pending sales, expenses, tanks, and cash collections. Prevents duplicate sync operations and invalidates relevant queries after successful sync.
Monitors both browser online status and backend reachability by periodically checking backend health via API calls. Tracks last successful connection time and provides combined connection status for offline-first functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality using DFINITY's AuthClient. Manages authentication state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable options for idle behavior and identity provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineStorage.ts: Manages offline storage of sales and expenses in localStorage, providing methods to add, retrieve, and clear pending data. Tracks pending item counts and provides utilities to check if offline data exists for synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: React hook that tracks browser online/offline status using navigator.onLine and window events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Comprehensive React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, cash collections, price updates, shopping items, and Stripe configuration. Provides both query and mutation hooks with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncOfflineData.ts: Hook for syncing offline sales and expenses data to the backend, tracking sync status, progress, and errors.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, container settings, border radius variables, shadows, and animations for accordions.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented and pending features for a petrol pump management system, including sales backdating, totalizer-based volume calculation, and shift timestamp management.
